reviewMethod.photographicComparison: Reviewer independently opened official/identified photographs, the full Trotamundo page and its specific bridge photograph; compared them with all eight final native views and sixteen final browser captures.
reviewMethod.browserEvidence: Root collected actual WebGL screenshots and DOM/console observations through the documented browser tool. Reviewer opened and visually examined the exact files, verified their portable copies by SHA-256, and audited the final camera/festival code. Offline Blender images are not counted as WebGL evidence.
reviewMethod.motionEvidence: Static moments before/after playback and one departure frame, supplemented by root UI observations, code inspection and independent time/pause/visibility tests. No claim of uninterrupted video review or physical-phone GPU testing.

references.observed: Seven specific photographs of the Minas portal, games, pergola, parador and quinchos; unrelated thumbnail images excluded.
Mature grove, clearings and family-play context in 2026; temporary tree-work machinery is excluded.
Official aerial of the oval festival arena and end-stage placement.
Current blue/light-metal roof, glazed sides and swimming lanes; historic uncovered diving-board photo is not used as the current entire complex.
PDF index6, printed page7: park paragraph and its timber bridge photograph, X railings, posts, deck and directional change. Full page was opened to distinguish it from the Artigas image below.
Only four images under the Parque Rodo section: rose/pergola walk, grove/picnic and Scout Guarani. Penitente and Verdun photos elsewhere on the page excluded.
Official stage/natural audience slope at Cerro Artigas and festival crowd/light structure; stage below the summit rather than on the pedestal.
Identity of Minas park, distinct OSE site and absence of a current zoo. No imported Montevideo castle/stone bridge/coastal setting.

criteria.name: Minas identity
criteria.finding: Portal, palm-lined access, family sector, pergola and oval arena are recognizable together; no unrelated Montevideo landmarks.

criteria.name: Entry structure
criteria.finding: Stone piers, light columns/horizontal canopy, oculi, metal arch and name are coherent in native and browser views; materials and precise dimensions remain approximate.

criteria.name: Sectors and terrain
criteria.finding: Specific X-railed wooden mirador, long pergola, pond, dry swimming base and curved arena tiers are coherent. Sector distances and complete bridge/shore plan are interpreted, not measured.

criteria.name: Current secondary elements
criteria.finding: Covered blue/glazed pool, family play and picnic structures; no zoo reconstructed as current. Native V2 water/pool overlap is resolved in final V4.

criteria.name: Night-only park festival
criteria.finding: Daytime arena empty; nighttime four-musician stage and instanced crowd are clearly lit. Repeat frames/code/time checks support staggered motion and connected human-scale bodies.

criteria.name: Night-only Artigas fogones
criteria.finding: Stage and crowd occupy the slope below the monument; night fireworks/campfires are visible; daytime group hidden. Sculpture, terrain, rocks and accepted flag order remain unchanged. Rocket launch positions moved behind the stage.

criteria.name: Animation, pause and modes
criteria.finding: Independent tests freeze event clocks/poses at equal times, animate at changed times, hide groups by day and extinguish offsite lights. Root observed playback and curtain/mode changes; snapshots do not certify continuous video.

criteria.name: Integrity and cost
criteria.finding: Final geometry/normals/indices pass; pool dry margin retained; independently computed grass/road/path/water face winding points upward. Instanced audiences and two actual point lights per event; no physical-device performance guarantee.

criteria.name: Actual WebGL and responsive UI
criteria.finding: Sixteen real browser captures cover desktop1440x900/mobile390x844 day/night and a partial320x568 entry/caption sample. Text rows separate, no reported horizontal overflow, root consoleErrors empty. Small viewport sample requires vertical scrolling for lower controls.

criteria.name: Preservation
criteria.finding: Ten public stops/thirteen visits; all nine original positions/order preserved, Villa Serrana remains Ventorrillo then Stewart Vargas, Artigas base geometry compared unchanged. Historical reviews not modified.

correctionHistory.resolution: V4 corrects road/path winding, internal tier faces and exterior/back seating closure; independently confirmed on packed triangles and final images.

limitations: Photograph-led stylized scenic reconstruction; condensed sector layout, approximate dimensions/materials/planting, not survey or photogrammetry.
The bridge reference establishes observed timber/X-rail/deck character and a turn, not a complete original plan or exact shoreline.
Night scenes evoke local festivals/Fogones and do not reproduce a specific edition or real artist lineup or imply an event every night.
Responsive acceptance is limited to the observed viewports and frames;320x568 is a partial reading/scroll sample, not a full-viewport survey of every scene.
Motion confidence combines code/tests and root browser observations with selected frames; no uninterrupted-video certification or physical-phone GPU benchmark.
Approval is for this park/Artigas event integration, not a blanket approval of every model, booklet page or the entire website.

publicationFollowups.scope: Publication continuity of the regression test only; no runtime/model/image changes.
publicationFollowups.reason: Two git show baseline reads now use the fixed accepted nine-stop revision instead of mutable HEAD, so committing the ten-stop integration cannot silently redefine the preservation baseline or create a false failure.
publicationFollowups.changeIsolation: Reversing only the new comment/acceptedRevision declaration and the two git show references reconstructs the exact previously reviewed script SHA-256.
